authority_input.precedence: Supplemental qualification authority beneath governing Gate 2 authority; projection is derivative, not an independent authority source.

refinements.name: PROCESS_INCARNATION_AND_REPLACEMENT_NEGATIVE_CONTROLS
refinements.title: Process incarnation and replacement
invariant: A PID is never sufficient authority for a later signal, wait, termination decision or cleanup verdict.
After process incarnation has been identified, any authority-reducing operation must use a stable kernel-bound process reference.
For the selected Linux implementation, use pidfd unless a future implementation proposes an independently justified equivalent and returns to Master Gate for approval.
PID/start-time remains corroborating identity evidence, not the effect handle.
The stable handle must bind RuntimeAttempt identity, grant, holder incarnation, boot identity, UID, executable, cgroup, namespace and fence/recovery generation.
Herdr PID/start-token/session identity is a test/reference source only; it is not the Gate 2 identity mechanism.
mandatory_negative_controls: actual holder/agent dies while wrapper survives
stale observation followed by attempted signal/wait/cleanup
expected_failure_disposition: replacement/stale identity is never treated as current authority
uncertain termination/ownership requires fencing, cleanup_unverified and quarantine/block-reuse as applicable

refinements.name: EVENT_GAP_AND_RESYNCHRONIZATION
refinements.title: Explicit event loss and resynchronization
invariant: An event gap, disconnect, owner restart or observation-generation mismatch makes the cached observation STALE.
A STALE observation cannot authorize an effect, release, cleanup verdict, retry or lifecycle success; a fresh authoritative reread/reconciliation is required.
Events are wakeups/invalidation hints, never lifecycle authority.
Do not treat a retained event as authoritative after its owning epoch is invalid.
Do not add a Herdr-style EventBus subsystem.
expected_failure_disposition: mark cached observation STALE and reject authority-dependent use
never consume partial event history as complete truth

refinements.name: PRE_EFFECT_OBSERVER_AND_READINESS_ORDERING
refinements.title: Observer and readiness before external effect
invariant: Required effect order: durable intent; operation identity fixed; required observer/readiness established; possible-effect acknowledgement boundary; external invocation; attributable observation/reconciliation.
Observer/readiness failure before effect means NO EFFECT.
Stale or earlier completion CANNOT satisfy the new operation.
A possible effect with a lost result remains ambiguous; NO blind replay.
This supplements the existing ProviderRequestRecord/effect ledger and does not replace durable intent or possible-send recording.
Do not adopt Herdr terminal prompt/wait semantics.
expected_failure_disposition: observer/readiness failure before effect produces no external effect
reject stale, wrong-operation or unrelated completion
retain possible-effect ambiguity and reconcile without blind replay

refinements.name: BOUNDED_CANCELLABLE_DIAGNOSTIC_DRAINAGE
refinements.title: Bounded cancellable diagnostic drainage
invariant: Keep retained memory bounded; continue drainage of excess where required.
Bound cancellation/termination and prevent deadlock merely because a diagnostic pipe filled.
Represent truncation and incomplete observation explicitly.
TRUNCATED != COMPLETE_EVIDENCE
PIPE_EOF != PROCESS_CLEAN
CHILD_REAPED != RESOURCE_CLEAN
BOUNDED_DRAINAGE != SECRET_REDACTION
Synthetic-secret qualification remains separately mandatory.
No Herdr SSH subsystem is adopted.
mandatory_negative_controls: owned child must still be reaped
expected_failure_disposition: record explicit TRUNCATED, CANCELLED or INCOMPLETE outcomes as applicable
do not promote truncated or incomplete diagnostics to complete evidence
retain process/resource cleanup obligations independently of EOF or child reaping
apply separate secret-disclosure and quarantine policy when required

transition_contract.owner: Trusted diagnostic collector under the current Symphony decision.
transition_contract.guard: A qualified bounded channel and current acquisition identity/readiness are established.
transition_contract.side_effect: Begin bounded concurrent drainage of all required streams.
transition_contract.failure_transition: INCOMPLETE if setup, collector or channel state cannot be established.
transition_contract.restart_interpretation: Interrupted acquisition becomes INCOMPLETE on recovery; restore no capture authority.
transition_contract.terminal_meaning: Nonterminal acquisition has begun; no complete-evidence or cleanup claim exists.

transition_contract.owner: Trusted diagnostic collector under the current Symphony decision.
transition_contract.guard: All required streams reached qualified completion without truncation or incompleteness; completion metadata can be durably finalized.
transition_contract.side_effect: Finalize and persist capture metadata with an untruncated transport-completion disposition.
transition_contract.failure_transition: INCOMPLETE if completion, attribution or metadata persistence is uncertain.
transition_contract.restart_interpretation: Retain CLOSED only from durable qualified completion facts; missing or ambiguous facts produce an INCOMPLETE recovered observation. Restore no capture authority.
transition_contract.terminal_meaning: Terminal capture-transport completion only. Evidence eligibility still requires its independent qualification and attribution checks; process/resource cleanup is not established.

transition_contract.owner: Trusted diagnostic collector under the current Symphony decision.
transition_contract.side_effect: Record truncation, stop retaining additional payload, and continue bounded drainage where required.
transition_contract.failure_transition: INCOMPLETE if drainage, bounds, truncation recording or collector state becomes uncertain.
transition_contract.restart_interpretation: Retain the truncation fact and mark interrupted acquisition INCOMPLETE; do not resume capture or restore authority.
transition_contract.terminal_meaning: Nonterminal transport handling continues; diagnostic evidence is truncated and cannot be complete evidence.

transition_contract.owner: Trusted diagnostic collector under the current Symphony decision.
transition_contract.guard: Drainage reaches qualified termination and the TRUNCATED disposition can be durably finalized.
transition_contract.side_effect: Persist final transport metadata and the sticky TRUNCATED disposition.
transition_contract.failure_transition: INCOMPLETE if termination or disposition persistence cannot be verified.
transition_contract.restart_interpretation: Retain CLOSED with TRUNCATED only from durable facts; uncertainty produces an INCOMPLETE recovered observation while preserving known truncation. Never promote truncated output to complete evidence.
transition_contract.terminal_meaning: Terminal transport handling is complete; evidence remains truncated. CLOSED does not erase truncation or establish process/resource cleanup.

transition_contract.owner: Trusted diagnostic collector under the current Symphony decision.
transition_contract.guard: The trusted owner issues a cancellation/deadline decision under the qualified bounded contract.
transition_contract.side_effect: Cancel/drain and reap the owned child according to the collector ownership contract; persist cancellation and any prior truncation. Scope cleanup remains separately verified.
transition_contract.failure_transition: INCOMPLETE if the bounded cancellation/drain/reap contract or disposition persistence cannot be established; retain unresolved cleanup obligations.
transition_contract.restart_interpretation: Preserve CANCELLED and any known truncation. Uncertain recovery facts remain INCOMPLETE; restart must never reinterpret cancellation as CLOSED or complete evidence.
transition_contract.terminal_meaning: Terminal diagnostic acquisition was cancelled and is never complete evidence. Cancellation does not certify process/resource cleanliness.

transition_contract.owner: Trusted diagnostic collector under the current Symphony decision.
transition_contract.guard: Any nonterminal observation, channel or collector state becomes uncertain, including an interrupted acquisition discovered on restart.
transition_contract.side_effect: Record an explicit incomplete disposition, preserve known truncation/cancellation facts, and retain unresolved resource obligations.
transition_contract.failure_transition: Remain INCOMPLETE on persistence/recovery failure; block evidence use and apply existing cleanup uncertainty/quarantine rules as applicable.
transition_contract.restart_interpretation: Preserve INCOMPLETE and restore no capture authority. Do not reinterpret it as CLOSED or complete evidence.
transition_contract.terminal_meaning: Terminal acquisition cannot satisfy an evidence requirement. A fresh qualified observation with current authorization and a new acquisition identity is required.

terminal_contract.closed_meaning: CLOSED records capture transport termination, not a process/resource cleanup verdict or an automatic complete-evidence verdict.
terminal_contract.sticky_dispositions: TRUNCATED, CANCELLED and INCOMPLETE facts cannot be erased by closure or restart. Evidence completion must not be inferred from a transport state.
terminal_contract.restart_rule: No acquisition authority is restored. A new acquisition requires a fresh acquisition identity and current Symphony authorization; it cannot relabel a prior terminal record.

refinements.name: RESOURCE_REPLACEMENT_CLEANUP_NEGATIVE_CONTROLS
refinements.title: Resource replacement during cleanup
invariant: Observe authorized object A at locator X; object A disappears or moves; replacement object B appears at locator X; cleanup reaches locator X.
DO NOT delete B.
DO NOT certify A absent merely from locator state.
Cleanup authority comes from stable Symphony allocation/ownership identity, not path equality.
Do not copy Herdr path-based compare-and-remove into a security-critical cleanup boundary.
mandatory_negative_controls: authorized object A at locator X disappears or moves before cleanup; replacement B occupies X
replacement of other stable resource locator where applicable
expected_failure_disposition: do not certify object A absent from locator state alone
identity mismatch requires cleanup uncertainty and quarantine/block reuse

rejects.rejected_mechanism: Herdr daemon inside Gate 2 trusted runtime
runtime access to HERDR_SOCKET_PATH or an equivalent broad control endpoint, including endpoint FDs and sibling/orchestration authority
live PTY/process handoff as authority continuity
child exit or PTY close as cleanup proof
Herdr Done/idle/status as Symphony lifecycle authority
raw terminal history/argv/plugin output as trusted evidence
reconnect as permission to replay ambiguous external effects
Herdr source/worktree operations as CandidateRef/publication replacement

p09_qualification.requirement: Verify applicable package evidence includes all five mandatory refinements; stronger mechanisms may satisfy the controls but omission is not permitted.

escalation_rule: STOP and return to Master Gate if satisfying a refinement requires changing frozen architecture, authority, credential ownership, publication semantics or package topology.
authorization_scope: Locks apply only to this documentation/research materialization. Separately granted P01 authority and programme H-100 authority are not modified.
